products.name: Lie Down, Skywalker
products.tagline: A bed, the sky, and nothing in between.
products.lede: A glass room with one job: put your bed under the stars. You fall asleep counting them and wake up already outside.
body: Four walls of glass and a ceiling of glass, on slim black steel with clean square corners. Inside, a plush bed, a brass reading lamp and a small heater with an ember glow that keeps the room warm while the snow comes down outside.

Set it at the bottom of the garden or out where the trees begin. It is the easiest way we know to spend more of your life outdoors, even the part you sleep through. Pull up the duvet, look up, and let the show start at dusk.
features: Flat glass walls and a full glass roof
Plush bed with a luxury mattress and linen bedding
Small ember-glow heater, warm through an Alberta winter
Total Eclipse Mode blackout shade for lie-ins
In Space No One Can Hear You Snore acoustic seals

products.name: Of Course I Still Tow You
products.kicker: The easy one everyone asks for
products.lede: Our easiest room to love. A tall mirror-glass front, a balcony that folds down to meet the grass, and a hitch that keeps your options open.
body: Built on a refurbished second-life trailer and finished like it was always meant to be beautiful. Park it at the forest edge this summer and somewhere new the next.
features: Refurbished second-life trailer, ready to tow
Fold-down glass balcony with glass rail
Wood entry door and cedar step

products.name: The Goldfish Protocol
products.lede: Our simplest room, and the easiest to say yes to. Clear walls, sliding windows, and the whole meadow pressed up against the glass.
body: Bright polycarbonate walls on slim white posts, wide sliding windows on every side and a cedar deck at the door. It lets the daylight do the decorating, so the inside stays calm, pale and uncluttered.
One room, set up your way: a quiet office, a living room or a bedroom. Start with one, add another when you are ready. Memory of a goldfish not required; you will remember this view.
features: Wide sliding windows on every side
Set up as an office, a living room or a bedroom

products.name: Hot Take
products.lede: A hot tub with a passport. Tow it somewhere beautiful, light the stove, and let the steam make its argument.
body: A wood-fired cedar tub inside a clear glass room, two panels open to the meadow, firewood stacked within reach. Levelling jacks find flat ground wherever the view is.
features: Clear glass enclosure, two opening panels
Refurbished tandem trailer, wheels and all

products.name: A Hitchhiker's Guide to the Guest Room
products.lede: Everything a guest needs to know, starting with Don't Panic. There is always a towel.
body: A long linen sofa that folds out to a double, a low oak table, and a long glass side that opens to the meadow and lets the wind in. Your guests will ask to stay another night. Let them.
features: Long linen sofa, folds out to a double
Long glass side that opens to the meadow
Towel hooks, with two towels, always
On a refurbished trailer, or set down for good

products.name: Behind Door Number One
products.lede: Outside, a long wall of smoked glass. Open one door, or all of them, and the whole side folds into the evening.
body: Inside: warm oak, a walnut desk and a linen sofa, lit low and gold. Neighbours see a mirror. You see the sunset. The room's whole personality is a plot twist.
features: Full-length run of folding glass doors
Smoked glass for privacy by day

products.name: A Starry Night
products.lede: The first Aura room, and still the one people point at. The long side opens and the evening walks in.
body: Honey oak walls and ceiling, a built-in linen sofa, and a deck with a lit edge and a river-stone border. It is the all-rounder: for long evenings, slow mornings and everything in between.
features: Deck with a lit edge and river-stone border

products.name: The Soak
products.lede: A wood-fired cedar tub on its own deck, a black-glass room to dry off in, and a swinging daybed for the part after. Bring your towel.
body: The tub steams on a dark deck in the tall grass. The room glows behind it, edged in river stones with soft light underneath, and the swinging daybed is for doing absolutely nothing at all.
features: Wood-fired cedar hot tub on its own deck
Black-glass room for changing and lounging
Velvet daybed swinging under a steel arch
Heated towel rail by the door

products.name: Tub-ward Bound
products.lede: A bedroom on wheels with a wood-fired cedar tub riding along on its own deck. Soak, dry off, and be asleep three steps later.
body: Obsidian glass outside, warm oak and a plush double bed inside, behind a glass side that slides wide open. The cedar tub sits on the back deck, or out in the tall grass if you prefer.
features: Wood-fired cedar hot tub on its own cedar deck
Plush double bed in warm oak
Glass side that slides wide open
Refurbished trailer, wheels and levelling jacks
Heated towel rail by the door

products.name: The Stargazer
products.lede: A bedroom with one job and a ceiling with no limit.
body: A plush king bed on a low oak platform, warm oak all around, and a glass roof that turns the whole night sky into the ceiling. The meadow waits at the end wall for the morning.
For lie-ins, the blackout shade closes over the glass and the room goes dark and perfectly quiet.
features: Plush king bed on a low oak platform
Glass skylight roof over the bed

products.name: Office Space Odyssey
products.lede: Somewhere between a writer's cabin and a starship bridge. Two walls of glass, one long walnut desk, and a commute measured in footsteps.
body: Glowing oak walls, a linen chair and glass on two sides facing the horizon. The corner panel swings open onto the grass, which is either the best feature or the most dangerous one.
Out here the wifi is strong, the distractions are weak, and the ideas show up early. Most people come back in. Eventually.
features: Corner glass door that opens to the meadow
Long walnut desk with brass lamp
Warm cove lighting for late finishes

products.name: Aurora's Looking Glass
products.lede: You see the whole meadow. The meadow sees its own reflection. Nothing to see here.
body: One-way mirror glass on the outside, a clear view from within. A low linen bed, a wide skylight for the Milky Way, and a full glass end wall that turns the night into the main event.
features: One-way mirror glass, clear view inside
Low linen bed that doubles as a daybed
Oak ledge shelf for books and lamps

products.name: Hot Tub Time Machine
products.lede: Step in at dusk. Step out whenever you like. Time behaves differently at forty degrees.
body: A round cedar tub with its own chimney stove, set inside a clear enclosure with a roof, so the snow becomes scenery. We build it ourselves, in our own shop, and it sets down level wherever you want to lose track of time.
features: Chimney stove with a glowing window
Steel and timber base that sets down level

products.name: Cool Runnings
products.lede: Feel the rhythm, feel the rhyme. Get on in, it's plunge time.
body: A long oval cedar bathtub for one, with a sloped backrest and smooth oiled rims. Fill it cold, step in brave, and come out feeling like you could win gold. Made in-house, on a low timber base for the frosted grass, the deck or the dock.
features: Single-person cedar bathtub, long and oval

products.name: Fire and Ice
products.kicker: Hot Tub Time Machine + Cool Runnings
products.lede: Heat, then the brave part, then heat again. The matched pair, side by side on one deck.
body: Our wood-fired hot tub and our cedar cold plunge, built together and finished to match. The oldest ritual in the north, made beautiful.

products.name: Thirst Contact
products.lede: Water from the sky, bottled in the backyard.
body: An atmospheric water generator, built right into the room. It draws moisture from the air, filters it and turns it into clean drinking water, so the freshest glass you will ever pour comes from the sky above your own roof. First contact has never tasted better.
features: Draws and filters water from the air

products.name: Leaf Skywalker
products.lede: Grow long and prosper. One long wall is a garden, and the roots live on mist.
body: A full-length aeroponic grow wall, its roots fed by a fine nutrient mist instead of soil. Timed grow light keeps the greens bright all winter, and the potting bench is right there when it is time to harvest dinner.

products.name: Jungle Book: Canopy Of Stars
products.lede: A small glass room in the rainforest, warm inside while the mist rolls through the trees. Costa Rica, by way of a very calm spaceship.
body: Smoked glass, honey oak and a linen sofa, set on a low deck among the ferns and palms. The canopy hums all night and the stars show up between the leaves.
It is the same Aura room, taken somewhere warmer and much greener. Bring a good book. The jungle will supply the soundtrack.
features: Linen sofa and warm cove lighting

products.name: The Forest Edge
products.lede: The long way round. A full-length glass side on all-terrain wheels, with the tub and the daybed already unpacked.
body: Long, dark and built for rough ground. Big tyres take it past where the gravel ends, and a heavy roof rack stands ready for Full Solar, so the farther you go, the quieter it gets.
features: Low metal roof, dark ribbed end walls
Cedar tub on a deck pad
Hanging daybed under a steel arch
Heavy roof rack, ready for Full Solar

products.name: Siddhartha's A-Wing
products.lede: Enlightenment, with a very steep roof. It comes with everything, including the net.
body: A black lodge with a full-height glass gable, a wide railed deck in the wildflowers and the mountains behind. A full kitchen, a rain shower, a sleeping loft, a wood stove and a hot tub on the deck. Nothing to add but yourself.
features: Deck netting and an interior loft net
Full kitchen, rain shower, sleeping loft

products.name: Cloud Nine
products.lede: Siddhartha found enlightenment. Cloud Nine found a gym, a TV station and three more nets to lie in.
body: Everything in Siddhartha's A-Wing, then more of all of it. A bigger deck with nooks beneath it, a walkout top-floor balcony with its own net, and walnut, stone and smart glass wherever you look.
features: Under-deck nooks for reading and napping
Nets on the deck, loft, balcony and below
Home gym and a TV station
Walnut, stone, smart glass, best linens

products.name: Pandora's Glass Stairway to Heaven
products.lede: Open the box and climb. Every level is glass, and the top one is all sky.
body: A round tower of curved glass, several decks high, every level glowing in the snow. An outside stair links lounge, bedroom and view levels, and the railed roof deck is where the evening ends.
features: Roof deck with rail and netting
Full kitchen and bathroom on the main level
In-floor heating and a wood stove

products.name: Waste of Space
products.kicker: The wastewater module, with a view
products.lede: Every beautiful room has something quietly going on behind the scenes. Ours comes with a rooftop deck.
body: Waste of Space looks after the black water and the grey water for your whole Aura setup. It runs long, because good plumbing takes room, so we dressed every metre of it in charred cedar and warm wood. Lay it on the ground beside your rooms and your solar, connect it, and never think about it again.

Then we gave the whole roof away. A stair climbs to a railed deck that runs end to end: a cedar hot tub, a hammock, a small gym corner and a telescope for the clear nights. Up there it is you, the stars, and the quiet satisfaction of lounging on top of your own system. Rise above it all. Literally.
features: Manages black water and grey water
A long module, with room for all the plumbing
Lays out on the ground and connects to the Aura system
Plugs in beside Full Solar and the other modules
Charred cedar and warm wood cladding
Stair to a railed deck across the whole roof
Rooftop cedar hot tub, hammock and small gym corner
A telescope corner for the clear nights
products.quote: The best seat in the house sits on top of its least glamorous job.

compare: Walkout balcony with its own net
Home gym and a TV station

limited.name: Of Course I Still Fly You
limited.text: A small amphibious plane on its own trailer, wings folded, parked beside a sleep-in Aura room. Land on the lake, fold the wings, and sleep a few steps from the water.

limited.name: Of Course I Still Float You
limited.text: An Aura room on pontoons, moored at the dock, the glass front facing the water.

limited.name: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under The Deck
limited.text: A full Aura houseboat with its own engine: bedroom, galley, glass all round and a roof deck for the evening.

limited.name: The Life Of Pontoon
limited.text: Pull it to the launch, float it off the trailer, and anchor wherever the view is best.

limited.name: The Quad Squad
limited.text: A garage bay at the back for a quad, an all-glass front for living. The back wall drops into a ramp and out it rolls.

someday: On stilts among the trees, with a rope bridge to a second room.
Two rooms joined by a short glass bridge.
A roof that slides back for open-sky nights.
A small observatory dome on the roof.
On tracks, for snowfields and frozen lakes.
Available on Mars, as soon as Mars is.
